proposed_widenings.name: shared_resource_pool
proposed_widenings.justification: Focus Points is a single level-scaled pool shared across Flurry of Blows, Patient Defense, and Step of the Wind. The current surface gives each ActivatedAbilityMechanics its own resource/resetCadence — there is no way to name a pool and have multiple activations draw from it. Encoding each sub-feature with its own use_count cap=1 would lie: a monk with 5 FP can use Flurry of Blows 3× and Patient Defense twice in one fight; independent use-counts would wrongly allow each feature once independently.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Your Monk level determines the number of points you have, as shown in the Focus Points column of the Monk Features table. When you expend a Focus Point, it is unavailable until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

proposed_widenings.name: grant_bonus_action_standard_action
proposed_widenings.justification: Patient Defense (free tier) grants 'take the Disengage action as a Bonus Action' and Step of the Wind (free tier) grants 'take the Dash action as a Bonus Action'. The existing grant_extra_action atom grants an additional Action (main-action economy), not a Bonus Action slot for a specific standard action. There is no atom for 'take StandardActionKind X as a Bonus Action'.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Patient Defense: You can take the Disengage action as a Bonus Action. Step of the Wind: You can take the Dash action as a Bonus Action.

proposed_widenings.name: grant_bonus_action_unarmed_strikes
proposed_widenings.justification: Flurry of Blows grants two Unarmed Strikes as a Bonus Action when 1 FP is expended. No existing atom covers a bonus-action multi-unarmed-strike grant. grant_extra_action is for the main Action economy; scale_attack_count widens the Attack action's attack count but does not grant a separate Bonus Action attack sequence.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Flurry of Blows: You can expend 1 Focus Point to make two Unarmed Strikes as a Bonus Action.

proposed_widenings.name: modify_jump_distance
proposed_widenings.justification: Step of the Wind's enhanced (1 FP) tier doubles jump distance for the turn. No existing atom covers jump distance modification. modify_speed adjusts walking speed; grant_speed adds a speed mode; neither covers the jump-distance multiplier the SRD defines as a separate movement property.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Step of the Wind (1 FP): your jump distance is doubled for the turn.

notes: The shared-pool gap is the blocking structural issue. Even if resolved, the three sub-features each require new atoms: (1) bonus-action standard-action grant, (2) bonus-action unarmed-strike grant, (3) jump-distance multiplier. Patient Defense and Step of the Wind each also have a two-tier shape (free BA version vs. enhanced FP version) that requires expressing optional resource expenditure for an upgraded effect — a pattern the current activation family does not support.
